newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Tennis-Capriati beaten, Hingis through to second round.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Tennis-Capriati beaten, Hingis through to second round.

text.p: U.S. tennis player Jennifer Capriati was surprisingly beaten in the first round of the Australian Open on Tuesday, losing in three sets to compatriot Jolene Watanabe.
Capriati, who is making a comeback after two years of well-publicised personal strife, was beaten 6-2 3-6 6-4.
Neither player was seeded in the tournament although Capriati had been in good form after reaching the final of the Sydney International tournament last Saturday.
Capriati was beaten in that tournament by Swiss teenager Martina Hingis, who won her first round match in Melbourne 6-1 7-5 against the experienced German Barbara Rittner.
Fourth seed Hingis will next meet Lisa Raymond of the United States. Raymond earlier defeated Australian wildcard Siobhan Drake-Brockman 6-2 6-2.
